title: Walking catchment of Mulago National Referral Hospital, Uganda

headline.label: buildings within a 15-minute walk of Mulago National Referral Hospital

data: OpenStreetMap streets and paths (highway ways, 745.3 km in the connected network), buildings (100,533 in the window) and the facility way/45353329 (Mulago National Referal Hospital), read through the Overpass API on 20 November 2026 (database state 2026-11-20), © OpenStreetMap contributors, licence ODbL (openstreetmap.org/copyright).
method: Built a walking graph from every highway way except motorways, construction and private ways, and kept the largest connected part (38,220 nodes).
Joined the facility to its nearest network node (17 m away).
Walking speed 4.8 km/h, so 5, 10 and 15 minutes are 400, 800 and 1,200 m along the network; shortest paths by Dijkstra, cutting edges where the time runs out.
Turned the reached streets into areas with a 50 m buffer and counted the OpenStreetMap buildings whose inside point falls in each.
limits: Network analysis, not a transport or traffic study. Walking is modelled at a constant 4.8 km/h with no slopes, crossings, waiting, steps penalty, sidewalk quality, safety or opening hours. The result is only as complete as the OpenStreetMap paths: a missing footpath shrinks the catchment and a wrongly connected one enlarges it.
